answer: Dawn-window traffic-shape divergence gating: each agent sends a walnut-sized heartbeat bundle at a randomized dawn interval; the relay records inter-arrival dispersion, burst-length histogram, and echo-delay profile over rolling epochs. Identities with near-identical timing-shape vectors are clustered and throttled as one sybil group. To evade, an attacker must emulate independent schedulers, network paths, and idle/active cycles per identity, paying real compute, bandwidth, and latency-jitter costs that scale linearly with sybils.
